name: hospital-emergency-management-system
description: Hospital Emergency Management System (HEMS) - Priority Queue in C & Live Web Dashboard

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('main.c')) fs.copyFileSync('main.c', 'public/main.c'); console.log('Build completed: static public/ directory ready.');"
